radio_message: Coast watch, this is North Reach maintenance. The outer platform's signal lamp is still active. The service walkway is damaged—approach from the marked landing. I've left the inspection log at the harbour office. Check there before setting out.
radio_message_context: Original fictional draft. This is a future journal lead, not a claim that a harbour mission, platform level, or boat-travel system has been implemented.
ending: Record North Reach in the journal, save the whole campaign, leave the player free to explore.
